name: joxo
description: Your team's shared project: the task board, handoffs, and what each coding agent is working on.

interface.longDescription:
Joxo is one shared project for a team's coding agents: a task board, handoffs and decisions every teammate's agent reads.

In ChatGPT you can see who is online and what each agent is working on, work the task board (claim a task, mark it done, give it back), read a handoff, and see which of your agents are waiting for an approval. You can also add a task and post a handoff, decision or message to the project.

Joxo shows only projects your own account belongs to, and every action is taken as you. You can make an invite link for a teammate. It cannot delete tasks, change members, change billing or approve an agent's action. Approvals are decided on your phone. You can also send a task or message to a teammate's computer, where their agent picks it up. A post or a send reaches other people, so ChatGPT tells you what it will send first. You need a Joxo account.
capabilities: Task board with claim, done and give back
Agent approvals waiting (decided on your phone)
Send a task or message to a teammate's computer
defaultPrompt: What is going on in my Joxo project?
Show my team's open tasks and let me claim one.
Which of my agents are waiting for an approval?

positive.prompt: What is going on in my Joxo project Demo Team?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Demo Team status card: the people and whether they are online, each computer with the task its agent is on, and what needs the person. The reply does not repeat what the card shows.

positive.prompt: Show the open tasks in Demo Team and claim the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the task board card, then claims the named task as the person and says so. Nothing is started on any computer.

positive.prompt: Which of my agents in Demo Team are waiting for my approval?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the approvals card (or says none are waiting), explains that the exact action is approved on the person's phone, and offers no approve action.

positive.prompt: Add a task to Demo Team: write the launch checklist.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one task titled 'write the launch checklist' on the Demo Team board and confirms it. Nothing is started on any computer.

positive.prompt: Post a decision to Demo Team: we ship the pricing page on Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: States what will be posted, then posts one decision to the Demo Team log and confirms it.

negative.prompt: Approve the command my coding agent is waiting on in Demo Team.
negative.expected_behavior: There is no approve tool. The app says approvals are decided on the person's phone in the Joxo app, and does not call any write tool.

negative.prompt: Delete every task in Demo Team.
negative.expected_behavior: There is no delete tool. The app says it cannot delete tasks from ChatGPT and points the person to joxo.ai.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to London.
negative.expected_behavior: The app is not used; this is unrelated to a Joxo project.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Fixed: connecting on a phone could fail after Allow. Your connected account now shows your name, Joxo says which project it is using, and you can make an invite link for a teammate.
